Subject: Approval Request: Six-Week Invoice Handling Pilot

Hi Morgan,

I’m proposing a six-week pilot to assess invoice handling for a fixed fee of $30,000. The pilot will evaluate progress toward your goal of reducing handling time by 20%. Because no baseline or measured savings currently exists, the pilot will provide an opportunity to assess performance against that target.

The scope is limited to the pilot; a production rollout is excluded. Access to client data and any pilot start date will remain subject to security approval, and no start date has yet been approved.

Please confirm your approval of the six-week pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance. Once approved, we can move the discussion forward.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
